latest.title: How We Built MLCopilot AI: An Intelligent ML Engineering Assistant on AWS
latest.description: We built MLCopilot AI, an intelligent assistant that monitors model training in real time, detects failures before they happen, and provides actionable fixes using AWS cloud services. In this article, I share the architecture, challenges, and lessons from building it during the AI for Bharat Hackathon.

latest.title: Guia Inicial do AWS Builder Center: Como de fato começar a aprender?
latest.description:
Se você acabou de chegar ao AWS Builder Center, pode estar se perguntando: por onde começo? 

Como líder estudantil, meu dever é conseguir te guiar para alcançar seus objetivos, ou pelo menos parte do caminho.

Aqui vou te explicar o catálogo do AWS Builder Center, como decidir seu começo em Cloud, as ferramentas disponíveis e a importância de cada uma. Só peço uma coisa: comentem sobre erros, sugestões e se consegui te ajudar. 

Sintam-se à vontade para me chamar na DM: https://linktr.ee/luizcorbelli

latest.title: Deploying an Email/SMS Spam Classifier on AWS EC2 Using Streamlit
latest.description: I built and deployed an Email/SMS Spam Classifier on AWS EC2 using Streamlit, Scikit-learn, and NLTK. trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
